title: Manifest writer claims and releases through claims.ts; judgeStop covers manifest lanes
body:
Evidence: ADR 0029 step 4 left two clauses of t-p6fqmfb (PR #1575) open: the manifest writer does not itself claim and release through src/task/claims.ts (lane.ts claims, then transitions; drop releases in the drop path owned by lane t-5sptxvr), and Stop has no judgeStop-level test for a manifest lane.
Outcome: the manifest writer transitions and claims or releases in one step through src/task/claims.ts (async claimTask against sync transition); test/hook has a judgeStop case with a bound krn-lane agent payload, cwd at the main checkout, no agent_transcript_path and the claim file removed: started-unshipped refused, shipped-and-dropped passes, a manifestless lane keeps today's verdict.
Proof: those judgeStop cases pass; grep for raw claim reads in src/lane prints none outside legacy.ts.
